name: R. J. Jewell
bio: R. J. Jewell returned from an eastern trip in May 1884, still undecided about his future occupation. In July 1884 he was named in an item about plants with double and triple heads eighteen inches long.
mentions: R. J. Jewell has returned from his eastern trip. As yet, he is undecided about his future occupation.
